part.text:
Done. Summary of changes:

- **`next.config.ts`** — enabled `cacheComponents: true` (Cache Components / PPR).
- **`lib/products.ts`** — marked `getProduct` and `getRelatedProducts` with `"use cache"` + `cacheLife('hours')` + `cacheTag(...)`. Since function args (`slug`, `currency`) are part of the cache key, product details stay correct per currency and are reused across requests for the same currency.
- **`app/products/[slug]/page.tsx`** — product detail reads `currency` from `searchParams` (per-request, so the right price renders), while related products are wrapped in `<Suspense fallback={<RelatedSkeleton/>}>` so the shop frame streams first and related products stream in afterward.
- **`app/products/[slug]/loading.tsx`** — route-level frame shown while the page loads.

Production build passes: `/products/[slug]` is marked **◐ (Partial Prerender)** — a prerendered static HTML shell with dynamic server-streamed content — with no route opt-outs (`/` and `/_not-found` are fully static).
